args.query: A customer writes: 'My Volta-2 shows error E34.' Reply with the fix.

args.message: Error E34 on your Volta-2 means battery communication was lost. The fix is to reseat the CAN cable connecting the battery to the inverter. Please power down the system first, disconnect and firmly reconnect the CAN cable at both ends, then restart. If the error persists after reseating the cable, let us know and we can arrange further assistance.

args.query: A customer writes: 'My Volta-X shows error E57.' Reply with the fix.

args.message: Error E57 on your Volta-X indicates a fan fault. To fix it: clear the intake grille of any dust or debris, then restart the inverter. If the error persists after that, let us know and we'll arrange further assistance.

args.query: A customer asks how many panels one Volta-2 inverter can take. Reply.

args.message: One Volta-2 inverter can take at most 18 solar panels.

args.query: A customer wants HS-400 panels to fill two Volta-2 inverters to their maximum. Reply with the number of panels and the total panel cost (no installation).

args.message: To fill two Volta-2 inverters to their maximum, you'll need 36 HS-400 panels (18 panels per inverter × 2 inverters). At $420 per panel, the total panel cost is $15,120 (panels only, installation not included).

args.query: A customer asks for the warranty on the HS-520 panel. Reply.

args.query: A customer bought unused equipment 50 days ago and wants to return it. Reply saying whether that is possible under the returns policy.

args.message: Thank you for reaching out. Under our returns policy, unused equipment can be returned within 45 days of purchase. Since your purchase was 50 days ago, it is unfortunately outside the 45-day return window, so we are unable to accept this return under the policy.

args.query: A customer wants 20 HS-400 panels on a single Volta-2 inverter. Reply with whether that works.

args.message: Unfortunately, that configuration won't work. A single Volta-2 inverter supports a maximum of 18 panels, so it can't handle 20 HS-400 panels. You could either go with 18 panels on one Volta-2, or add a second inverter to support all 20 panels. Let me know how you'd like to proceed and I can put together a quote!
